Replay the flow from a bug report: a GitHub issue, or a .flow file.

```sh
proof repro [--json] [--max-lines <max-lines>] <target> [--var <var> ...]
```

From an issue, proof takes the first ```flow block (or the first code block made only of flow steps),
saves it as the flow issue-<number> and replays it from a fresh launch. Exit 1 means the bug reproduced.
```text
proof repro 123
proof repro https://github.com/acme/app/issues/123
proof repro ~/Downloads/checkout-crash.flow
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--max-lines <max-lines>` | Cut text output to this many lines; the rest goes to ~/.proof/last-output.txt. Also PROOF_MAX_LINES. |
| `<target>` | Issue number or URL, or a .flow file. **Required.** |
| `--var <var>` | NAME=value for ${NAME}. Repeatable. Repeatable. |
